question.worked_solution:
Here, we have the product of two functions $u(x)={x}^{2}$ and $v(x)=\operatorname{csch}⁡4x.$ So, we apply the product rule:

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & ={({x}^{2})}^{′}\cdot \operatorname{csch}⁡4x+{x}^{2}\cdot {(\operatorname{csch}⁡4x)}^{′} \\  & =2x\cdot \operatorname{csch}⁡4x+{x}^{2}\cdot (-4\operatorname{csch}⁡4x\operatorname{coth}⁡4x) \\  & =2x\operatorname{csch}⁡4x-4{x}^{2}\operatorname{csch}⁡4x\operatorname{coth}⁡4x \\  & =2x\operatorname{csch}⁡4x\cdot {{(1-2x\operatorname{coth}⁡4x)}_{⏟}}_{g(x)}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $g(x)=1-2x\operatorname{coth}⁡4x.$
